_: Every `references/` file, and when it is supposed to reach the model.
The reason this file exists: a reference is invisible when it fails. Nothing
raises, nothing logs, the answer still arrives - just written from memory
instead of from the method. So the expectation has to be written down next
to the file, the way cases.json writes the correct behaviour next to a case.
expect:  required   the run is wrong if this reference was NOT asked for
forbidden  the run is wrong if it WAS - it cost tokens for nothing
optional   allowed either way (the default for a scenario not listed)
scenarios, named after the runs that actually exist:
titluri          the D1B TITLES run, once per batch
detalii-reel     the D1B DETAILS run, format Reel, ten per batch
detalii-carusel  the same, format Carusel
detalii-stories  the same, format Stories
chat-faza1       the CLI conversation, phase 1
chat-productie   she asks about filming, editing or posting
`when` is Romanian and stays Romanian: it is the sentence that belongs in
SKILL.md, and it is copied from there when it is already written there.
`proposed: true` marks a trigger nobody has decided yet - the file is on
disk, no SKILL.md points at it, and the line below is a suggestion waiting
for a verdict. Not a fact. Remove the flag when it becomes one.

references.when: Faza 2, format Reel — structura în patru pași, șabloanele de text pe ecran și reelurile lucrate cap-coadă, într-un fișier.
Faza 2, format Carusel — cele patru caruseluri lucrate slide cu slide, singurul loc din metodă unde caruselul e arătat, nu descris.
Faza 2, format Stories — secvența de 3–7 story-uri plus tiparele de idee și exemplele de storytelling, într-un fișier.
